rationale: C22 is the directive expressly referenced and partially displaced by the child. Its section 1(b) establishes the nonpermanent treatment of promotions and permits reassignments to be permanent or nonpermanent; the child uses a 'Notwithstanding' clause to authorize regulations governing the permanency of those same personnel actions. It also preserves C22's division of authority between the Civil Service Commission for competitive-service positions and agency heads for positions outside that service. C23 offers a closely parallel notwithstanding-and-permanency formulation but concerns appointments in the postal field service. C05 shares the competitive/excepted-service framework but not the child's operative machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Notwithstanding the provisions of section 1 (b) of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of November 13, 1950
shared_material.parent_excerpt: On and after September 1, 1950 ... all promotions ... shall be on a nonpermanent basis; and ... any reassignment may ... be on either a permanent or nonpermanent basis.
shared_material.explanation: The child expressly identifies and modifies C22's operative provision governing the permanence of promotions and reassignments.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Civil Service Commission, with respect to positions in the competitive service, and the heads of executive departments and agencies, with respect to positions excepted from the competitive service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Civil Service Commission for positions in the competitive service, or the head of the agency concerned for positions outside the competitive service
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses C22's distinctive two-track allocation of personnel authority between the Commission and agency heads.

shared_material.child_excerpt: are hereby authorized to issue regulations or instructions governing the permanency of promotions and reassignments
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Civil Service Commission is authorized to prescribe regulations and procedures ... for carrying out its functions and duties under this order.
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C22's regulatory mechanism to reverse or qualify C22's restrictions for the specified personnel actions.
